brief:
Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas said he hopes the election of a new Israeli government will enable the resumption of peace talks, Middle East Eye reported. Abbas did not specify conditions or timelines for potential negotiations.

The statement comes as Israel prepares a new government following recent elections. Abbas's remarks signal Palestinian willingness to engage diplomatically, though no formal talks have been scheduled.

title: Abbas expresses hope for peace talks with new Israeli government
